name: AP Internal Linking Helper
author: apsystemslab

sections.description:
AP Internal Linking Helper adds a fast, distraction-free sidebar to the block editor that suggests internal links while you write.

It’s built for writers, bloggers, and small site owners who want better internal link coverage without running a full SEO suite or dealing with complicated setup. The plugin scans your existing posts and pages, then surfaces suggestions you can copy or open directly from the editor.

Key points:

  • Editor-only helper – it doesn’t change your theme or front end.
  • No configuration required for basic use.
  • Works alongside your existing SEO plugin or workflow.

Need more control?

If you outgrow the free version, AP Link Helper Pro adds:

  • One-click insertion into selected text.
  • More suggestions per post for content-heavy sites.
  • Rules and exclusions to filter what appears.
  • Optional AI-assisted anchor ideas, generated from your own content.

Learn more and purchase Pro here:
https://noo0oobep-eng.github.io/ap-systems-lab-site/

How It Works

Open the editor, enable the “AP Link Helper” panel, and use the suggestions to add internal links quickly.
sections.faq:
Does this work with posts and pages?

Yes.

Does it require configuration?

No. It works out of the box.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. AP Link Helper Pro adds one-click insert, more suggestions, rules/exclusions, and optional AI anchor suggestions. You can learn more and buy Pro here:
https://noo0oobep-eng.github.io/ap-systems-lab-site/
